resolved_findings.summary: createDecipheriv(aes-256-gcm) called without {authTagLength:16}, then setAuthTag() on a stored attacker-influenceable value. Node accepts 4-16 byte GCM tags, so a truncated tag drops authentication from 128 to 32 bits. Contextual severity medium: requires prior write access to the workspace credential store. Defence-in-depth in the credential vault; cheap to fix; product is not installed or running.
resolved_findings.fix: pass {authTagLength:16} to createDecipheriv and validate the decoded tag length is exactly 16 before setAuthTag, at all 4 sites
resolved_findings.found_by: semgrep via noesar-debuglab, first HUNT AND FIX sweep
resolved_findings.fix_applied: authTagLength pinned to GCM_TAG_BYTES=16 on both createCipheriv and createDecipheriv, plus an explicit tag-length check before setAuthTag, at all 4 sites
resolved_findings.evidence: vulnerability reproduced first (a 4-byte tag decrypted successfully before the fix); 8 new regression tests in services/reference-control-plane/test/gcm-tag-length.test.mjs; full product suite 137/137 pass (was 129 delivered + 8 new); semgrep re-scan of services/ and ai-workspace/ reports 0 gcm-no-tag-length findings
